reproducer.text: At mncs-language revision 6b8c979, regenerate Harness frozen artifacts and invoke the pre-refresh mncs_runtime against harness_pins or harness_atlas. Physical exports are qualified names such as mncs_mncs_harness_pins_v1__pin__fields__valid while the runtime requests pin_fields_valid and refuses before execution.

requiredBehavior: Compiler-generated artifacts must expose a stable, documented source-level function contract for execution adapters even when backend export names are qualified or escaped; adapters must validate artifact identity and invoke the stable contract without rewriting generated artifacts.
summary: Current mncs-language artifact generation preserved stable source-level function names in function_value_contracts while emitting qualified backend export names. The pre-refresh Harness runtime treated physical exports as the semantic API and failed closed before invoking valid decision kernels.
title: Current compiler artifacts separate source function contracts from backend export names
